page.overview:
Who is Mauler Twins?

Several variants of the Mauler Twins appear as overarching antagonists in Invincible Season 2. While they share many traits with the original Mauler Twins, they come from alternate universes and exhibit distinct differences.

Most of them were voiced by Kevin Michael Richardson, but the voice actress of the Female Mauler is currently unknown.

The Mauler Twins or at least countless variants of themselves were summoned by Angstrom Levy to stop Invincible from interfering with his plans. After four of them had him pinned and weakened, they took it to far and nearly killed Invincible, resulting in their own demise. Angstrom removed his helmet that severed the connection to the machine meant to transfer knowledge from his variants, despite the pleas from the fools, thus the building imploded with all of them in it. Their burned corpses were seen afterwards, confirming their demises.

While all of the Mauler variants were killed, the mainstream Mauler Twin survived after the warehouse was destroyed.

Also known as: Mauler Twins villains.
